top_signals.title: US Stocks Jump as July Jobs Report May Ease Rate Hike Pressures
top_signals.summary: US stocks were higher on Friday after jobs data showed the US economy unexpectedly shed jobs in July, which could prompt the Federal Reserve to delay interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Japan’s GPIF posts $152 billion gain with help from stocks
top_signals.summary: The Government Pension Investment Fund, one of the world's largest, had an unprecedented ¥24.1 trillion quarterly gain, an 8.2% return, with assets totaling ¥317.76 trillion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
